verdict.rationale: Galileo's background automation is limited to monitoring-style behavior: alerts that fire automatically when cost or hallucination rates exceed expectations, and continuous evals (Luna models) running over production traffic. There is no evidence of user-defined, general-purpose automations or workflows that act autonomously. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring jobs (e.g., scheduled experiments), autonomous actions beyond alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
